## Shared Utilities Strategy

### Input System Architecture
- **InputManager**: Centralized input state management with unified controller abstraction
- **KeyboardController**: WASD/Arrow key handling with deadzone filtering
- **GamepadController**: Gamepad API integration with axis/button mapping

### Audio Synthesis Pipeline
- **AudioManager**: Web Audio API context manager with gain control
- **SoundSynth**: Procedural sound effect generation (explosions, power-ups, UI sounds)
- **MusicSynth**: Procedural music generation using oscillators and envelopes

### Particle System Manager
- **ParticleManager**: Centralized particle pool with strict 500-particle cap
- **ExplosionBurst.js**: Multi-layered explosion effects with shockwave rings
- **SparkBurst.js**: High-speed spark particles for impacts
- **ShockwaveRing.js**: Expanding emissive ring system

### Camera Shake System
- **CameraShakeSystem.js**: Trauma-based shake with decay curves and impact velocity scaling

### Procedural Texture Generation
- **NoiseTextures.js**: Simplex noise textures for materials, terrain, surfaces
- **NeonGlowTextures.js**: Canvas-based neon glow patterns and emissive maps

### Physics Utilities
- **PhysicsUtils.js**: Collision detection math, trajectory calculations, impulse responses

## Compliance Statement

### Anti-Lazy Directive Compliance ✅
**CONFIRMED**: No placeholder syntax will be used. Every function will contain complete, production-ready logic with no `// ... rest of the function`, `// ... insert logic here`, or `// ... previously defined code` comments. All implementations will be fully realized from start to finish.

### Strict Memory Management Compliance ✅
**CONFIRMED**: All Three.js objects (geometries, materials, textures) will have explicit `.dispose()` calls when no longer needed. Object pooling will be implemented for all projectiles, entities, and particles to prevent garbage collection overhead. No memory leaks will occur through proper resource lifecycle management.

### Sequential Output Protocol Compliance ✅
**CONFIRMED**: All code output will follow sequential execution order with complete function implementations. Token limit overflow handling includes continuation protocol: if output truncates, resume from exact character position without preamble or restart.
